comment: Advisories the audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) tolerates, and only
because no upstream fix exists yet. Every entry must be dev-only, must
carry an expiry, and is re-checked on each run: the gate fails if an
entry expires, if the advisory starts affecting a production dependency,
or if it stops matching (upstream shipped a fix — delete the entry).
This file is not a way to silence a fixable finding. If `npm audit` can
resolve it with an override or an upgrade, do that instead.

allow.reason: Globparts-amplification DoS in minimatch <11.0.1 (published 2026-10-30). The only patched line is the brand-new 11.x major (first release 2026-10-27), whose CommonJS build exposes named exports only. Every copy in this tree is lint tooling that still pins the 3.x callable-default API (eslint 9, @eslint/eslintrc, eslint-config-next -> eslint-plugin-import/jsx-a11y/react) or ^10 (@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree); none has moved to 11 yet and no 3.x/10.x backport exists, so an override would crash `npm run lint`. Dev-only: minimatch is reached solely through eslint and its plugins, never through a production dependency. Re-check when eslint / eslint-config-next / typescript-eslint publish minimatch ^11 dependents; the gate fails once this entry stops matching.
